title: SimpleCoords
description: A lightweight Utility Mod to Display XYZ, Subchunk Coordinates, Directions with userfriendly Configuration.
body:
**SimpleCoords** is a lightweight, client-side Utility Mod keep your essential navigation data visible at all times. It adds a minimalist HUD that displays your current XYZ coordinates, subchunk position and Direction.

Useful for Building Farms that require Precise Sub Chunk Placements or as an overall Coordinates Hud

Features:

- Minimalist Overlay: Non-intrusive coordinate display.

- Subchunk Info: Great for technical builds and slime chunk finding.

- Highly Compatible: Works on vanilla servers since it is client-side only.

- Customizable: Toggle features via in-game commands or the config file.
